events.title: David Chaum proposes cryptographic digital cash
events.summary: David Chaum presented Blind Signatures for Untraceable Payments at CRYPTO '82, describing cryptographic techniques that could support privacy-preserving electronic payments.
events.significance: Chaum's blind-signature work is one of the clearest technical ancestors of later digital cash and cryptocurrency.

merged_raw_records.note: Raw capture dated this influence row to 1983; it describes the same 1982 blind-signature work.
